issues.evidence: Process schema accepts candidate={} and labels valid="yes",claim_correct=null,progress=[],usefulness={}; all value types and candidate shape absent.
issues.fix: Require exact typed public candidate and complete evaluation label shapes; reject unexpected fields.

issues.evidence: Process output is a whole-candidate evaluation, not per-step rewards; READMEs do not define this. Preference chosen can itself be invalid (10/180) or claim-incorrect (44/180), still strictly better.
issues.fix: Document candidate-level labels, first_error interpretation, and strict relative preference semantics including both-bad pairs.

issues.evidence: Plan-count differences 60/60/60; response character differences 70/40/70; equal-plan-length is not exact byte/token matching. All90 pair groups occupy both positions.
issues.fix: Describe plan-count controls accurately and avoid exact response-length control claims.

issues.evidence: Filter is valid AND reaches_goal for submitted plan; no shortest-plan predicate. All28 pilot-v3 outputs exact, six empty.
issues.fix: Describe successful verified submitted trajectories; do not imply shortest fresh plans or nonempty optimal rollouts.

review_method: Independent prompt-derived recomputation of every existing RVM pilot-v2 candidate and every emitted pair using my own independent_review.py; actual agent inspection of exporter, public contracts and derived schema/docs. No reference/oracle or other verdicts read.
scope_limitation: Code review only; no dataset acceptance for expansion; no release authorization.
